title: Birthplace in the Seventh Ward and the St. Bernard market
summary: Zardis was born on North Robertson in the Seventh Ward and recalls bands playing at the St. Bernard market.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: town you came from, or you were born right in the city here.

I was born right here in the Seven Ward, see that's at St. Bernard and Robertson, between St. Bernard and Annette, the 1600 block, that's 1650 North Robertson. I'll never forget that number. Yeah. That was some good old days. Because at that time we used to play at the market. The market used to be open. The same Bernard market? The same Bernard market, yeah. The same band there. That's what I tell you. Did that band been together? Yeah, the same band.
